name: Sunshine
source:
Conflicted between who he likes, he needs to find the one that will help him. The one that will be his sunshine.

[From [url=https://roomiertiger.itch.io/sunshine] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他在喜欢谁之间犹豫不决，需要找到能帮助自己的人，找到那个将成为自己阳光的人。

[来源：[url=https://roomiertiger.itch.io/sunshine]itch.io[/url]]
